content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has established an Insulin Access and Affordability Working Group to address issues related to the cost and accessibility of insulin. This group has conducted a comprehensive analysis of the insulin supply chain to identify the factors that influence insulin pricing. Their investigation involved gathering insights and perspectives from various stakeholders involved in the supply chain. Based on this analysis, the ADA has issued specific recommendations aimed at improving the affordability of insulin, which have been published in an official ADA statement.
